description: Verify a signed PhaseFolio export by content hash. Returns verification status (valid/tampered/unknown), issued timestamp, methodology version, and an anonymized originating-org identifier. Use this when a user shares a PhaseFolio asset snapshot and you want to confirm it's authentic before citing the analysis.

hash.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 of the signed artifact's content. Embedded in every signed PhaseFolio PDF (footer) and Excel (cover tab).

name: verify_export

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

benchmark_dataset_versions.description: Array of benchmark dataset versions used; '[]' for legacy rows.

engine_version.description: Deprecated alias of model_version, kept for existing clients.

methodology_version.description: Methodology version stamp at signing time, e.g. 'methodology@2026-04'.

model_version.description: Model version stamp at signing time. Sentinel 'unknown (pre-2026-05)' for legacy rows.

org.description: Anonymized originating-org identifier, or display name if the org opted into public attribution.

signals_used.description: Reviewed drug-specific signal provenance included in the signed content hash; [] for none or legacy rows.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the artifact was signed at.
